settings.order: source and tail cap, track gain/pan automation, ordered track effects, tail cap, s16 track elements; sum, master gain, ordered master effects, tail cap and final trim/pad, VO ducking, s16 master; trim/pad pre-master stems to master frames
settings.automation: absolute values; step or outgoing linear segment; gain interpolated in dB; rounded sample positions
settings.ducking: trailing 20ms channel-energy RMS; threshold gate; exponential reduction in dB; v1

samples.timing: nearest absolute trigger and fixed boundary, ties later; ceil minimum only without fixed boundary; tick * usPerQuarter * 44100 / 960000000

settings.rate: 0.25 through 4; pitch and duration change together; no time-stretching
settings.interpolation: band-limited Kaiser-windowed sinc, 32 zero crossings per side, beta 8.5, 512 table steps per crossing with linear table interpolation; cutoff 0.92 x min(1, 1/rate) of source Nyquist; weights normalized to unity DC gain; silence outside the source; kernel from IEEE-754 basic arithmetic
settings.glide: rate linear in output frames from playbackRate to glide.to over the glide frames, then held; read position is the closed-form integral per frame
settings.offset: whole source frame: offsetSeconds as microseconds * 44100 / 1000000, nearest frame, ties later
settings.exactPath: rate 1 without glide copies source frames from the offset; no interpolation
settings.end: voice stops at the first output frame whose read position reaches the source length; no fades
settings.velocity: round(value * velocity) per voice sample, as for unperformed voices

settings.source: exclusive source end; explicit slice silences interpolation taps outside [offset,end); V0.6 interpolation unchanged otherwise
settings.envelope: linear output-frame attack from zero; a scheduled gate/choke release freezes attack gain at its onset; source/output exhaustion compresses overlapping fades proportionally, retaining the authored attack level at the peak and never delaying a gate; last rendered frame reaches zero; defaults 1ms attack, 5ms release; explicit zero disables a fade
settings.stop: gate or earliest later same-track choke onset starts release; stop + release capped by source exhaustion and permitted audio boundary; no source extension
settings.choke: track-local group; equal output-frame onsets coexist; each older voice uses its own release; a release already started is never restarted
settings.rounding: seconds to exact microseconds then nearest frame, ties later; gate via difference of rounded absolute musical boundaries

timeline.rounding: nearest sample frame; ties later; combined musical timeline + explicit tail rounded once

production.stemAlignment: trim/pad to master frames; post-track, pre-master gain/effects/ducking
